# Rectangle Overlap

## Solution

```python
class Solution:
    def isRectangleOverlap(self, rec1: List[int], rec2: List[int]) -> bool:
        return (rec1[0] < rec2[2] and
                rec2[0] < rec1[2] and
                rec1[1] < rec2[3] and
                rec2[1] < rec1[3])
```
